depicts: A stylized Z of dark scratched stone with glowing red bevelled edges, flanked by angular arrow-like shapes, on a black background.
composition: Emblem is centred and fills most of the square frame with small even margins; no part is cut off.
tone_and_contrast: Bright saturated red edges against near-black background; grey stone faces are darker than the red but separate clearly from black. Strong colour contrast.
sharpness_and_artifacts: Edges of the shapes are clean; scratch texture on the faces and faint speckle or droplet marks in the black background. No watermarks or overlays visible.
scan_first_read: A bold red-edged Z emblem on black.
